title: Micron, SK Hynix stocks sink as AI chip sell-off deepens
excerpt: A sell-off in semiconductor stocks deepened on Tuesday.
content_html:
What happened: Semiconductor stocks fell on Tuesday, with the PHLX Semiconductor Index (^SOX) falling more than 3% as investors continued to unwind positions in one of the market's hottest AI-driven sectors this year.

US-listed shares of memory and storage leaders Micron Technology (MU) and SK Hynix (SKHY) tumbled more than 8%, while Sandisk (SNDK) dropped 13%. Among the semiconductor equipment makers, ASML (ASML), Applied Materials (AMAT), and Lam Research (LRCX) also dropped.

AI chip heavyweight Nvidia (NVDA) stock reversed early morning losses to climb into green territory following a 5% drop on Monday. Peer AMD (AMD) fell more than 7%. Chip maker Intel (INTC), along with Marvell (MRVL) and Qualcomm (QCOM), also slid.

What's behind the move: The sell-off followed declines in semiconductor stocks abroad. In South Korea, SK Hynix fell more than 14%, while Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) dropped more than 13%.

European semiconductor stocks also moved lower as concerns about circular financing and intensifying competition from China have weighed on the sector.

On Monday, Nvidia lost its position as the world's most valuable company to Apple after a report said the AI chip heavyweight was in talks to backstop $250 billion in funding for OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) tied to a major data center project. That report followed a $500 billlion strategic collaboration with the conglomerate SK Group, announced on Friday.

Chinese memory maker CXMT's (688825.SS) blockbuster debut in Shanghai this week also renewed investor concerns that the company's rapid expansion could weigh on memory chip prices.

Additionally, a report from The Information that a Chinese state-backed company began mass-producing a key piece of chipmaking equipment fueled a sell-off in ASML shares.

What else you need to know: Semiconductor stocks have been at the center of the AI trade this year, helping propel the sector to a record high in June. Since then, chip stocks have tumbled into bear-market territory, falling more than 20% from their highs as investors grow increasingly concerned about hyperscalers' massive AI spending spree.

Investors have also become more skeptical about the payoff from billions of dollars in AI infrastructure investments, raising questions about whether the spending will generate adequate returns.

Last week, Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) stock plummeted after the tech giant announced it would raise its capital spending outlook as it builds out its AI infrastructure.

Investors are now awaiting earnings this week from Microsoft (MSFT), Amazon (AMZN), and Meta (META), all of which are expected to announce further increases in AI-related spending.

content_html_zh:
发生了什么：半导体股票周二下跌，PHLX 半导体指数 (^SOX) 下跌超过 3%，因为投资者继续减仓今年市场最热门的人工智能驱动行业之一的头寸。

美国上市的内存和存储龙头美光科技 (MU) 和 SK 海力士 (SKHY) 股价下跌超过 8%，Sandisk (SNDK) 下跌 13%。 半导体设备制造商中，ASML（ASML）、Applied Materials（AMAT）和 Lam Research（LRCX）也下跌。

AI 芯片重量级 Nvidia (NVDA) 股票在周一下跌 5% 后扭转了早盘跌势，攀升至绿色区域。 同行AMD（AMD）跌幅超过7%。 芯片制造商英特尔 (INTC)、Marvell (MRVL) 和高通 (QCOM) 也出现下滑。

此举背后的原因：抛售是在国外半导体股票下跌之后发生的。 韩国方面，SK海力士跌幅超过14%，三星电子（005930.KS）跌幅超过13%。

由于对循环融资和中国竞争加剧的担忧对该行业造成压力，欧洲半导体股票也走低。

周一，英伟达将全球最有价值公司的地位让给了苹果，此前有报道称，这家人工智能芯片巨头正在就支持 OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 与一个大型数据中心项目相关的 2500 亿美元资金进行谈判。 该报告是在周五宣布与企业集团 SK 集团进行价值 5000 亿美元的战略合作之后发布的。

中国内存制造商长鑫存储（688825.SS）本周在上海的重磅亮相也再次引发了投资者的担忧，即该公司的快速扩张可能会打压内存芯片价格。

此外，The Information 的一篇报道称，一家中国政府支持的公司开始大规模生产一种关键的芯片制造设备，引发了 ASML 股票的抛售。

您还需要了解什么：半导体股票一直是今年人工智能交易的中心，帮助推动该行业在 6 月份创下历史新高。 此后，随着投资者越来越担心超大规模企业的大规模人工智能支出热潮，芯片股跌入熊市，从高点下跌了 20% 以上。

投资者对数十亿美元的人工智能基础设施投资的回报也变得更加怀疑，质疑这些支出能否产生足够的回报。

上周，科技巨头 Alphabet（GOOG、GOOGL）宣布将提高其人工智能基础设施建设的资本支出前景后，该公司股价暴跌。

投资者目前正在等待微软 (MSFT)、亚马逊 (AMZN) 和 Meta (META) 本周发布的财报，预计所有这些公司都将宣布进一步增加人工智能相关支出。
